result.quote: Uzziah, with a censer in his hand to offer incense, was enraged. But while he raged against the priests in their presence in the house of the LORD before the altar of incense, leprosy broke out on his forehead.
result.reason: The key is supported, but the wording does not make it unique. The verse also says Uzziah “was enraged” while the censer was in his hand, so that is another defensible answer. The question should specify that it is asking what physical affliction appeared.
